title: Hypersphere-Based Restricting Conditions for Colorings of the Euclidean Space
summary: We study colorings of the Euclidean space constrained by \emph{hypersphere forcing conditions}: if an admissible hypersphere, $S_r(p)$, centered at a point $p$ and of radius $r$ contains a monochromatic set of points satisfying a certain property $\mathcal{P}$, then the center of the hypersphere must have that color. These forcing conditions may be restricted in applicability to a specific set of hyperspheres $S_r(p)$.
